meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析测序数据,产出质控报告与信号图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做基因组测序研究,需要把比对数据转成可视化结果。
copy.tagline_en: Turn sequencing data into QC charts and genome-wide signal maps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study genomes and need to visualize sequencing data for QC.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能处理测序数据:把 BAM 转成 bigWig 覆盖度轨道,做质控(相关性、PCA、指纹图),并生成 TSS、峰区的热图与信号曲线,面向 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 等实验。
howto.when: 当你要把 BAM 转 bigWig、做 ChIP-seq 质控,或在 TSS、峰区画热图与信号曲线时,它会接管使用。

say.text: 把这些 BAM 转成 bigWig 覆盖度轨道
say.note: 会先校验文件,再用 bamCoverage 生成轨道

say.text: 帮我做 ChIP-seq 质控:相关性、PCA、指纹图
在 TSS 附近做信号热图和曲线图

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can process sequencing data: convert BAM files to bigWig coverage tracks, run QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprint), and generate heatmaps and profiles around TSS or peaks for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq.
howto.when_en: Use it when converting BAM to bigWig, running ChIP-seq QC, or making heatmaps and profiles at TSS or peaks.

say_en.text: Convert these BAM files into bigWig coverage tracks
Run ChIP-seq QC: correlation, PCA, fingerprint plots
say_en.note: Generates a workflow script and runs it

say_en.text: Make a signal heatmap and profile around the TSS
